'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Sam Marlow DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sam Marlow]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' Hari Seldon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
